chunks: If We took compassion on them and removed the affliction they are in, they would only wander lost in confusion.
ai.seo_question: Why do disbelievers persist in arrogance even when God relieves their suffering?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological state of the disbelievers (kuffar) who, despite experiencing divine mercy, fail to reflect and remain entrenched in their arrogance. It underscores the concept that relief from hardship often leads to complacency rather than gratitude, as they continue to wander blindly in their transgression. This reflects the broader theme of divine testing through both ease and difficulty.
